lines.en: I'm a former paper executive. I know the product. I know the margins. I can save you 25% on your costs.
Why haven't I heard of you? You got any references?
Which is the best part. That means you will be my first customer, and your business will get 100% of my attention.
Now, I have written down my personal phone number.
Every salesman I've ever met has given me his personal phone number.
Of course they have, which is why I'm giving you a key to my house.
Whatever you need, anytime, night or day, you just stop on by.
You want me to drive to your house if I need paper?
Maybe you just want someone to talk to. Maybe you need a place to crash for a couple of days.
My wireless password is eat, pray, love. Easy to remember.
Ready? Go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go, go.
Go, go, take the stairs, now.
I don't even know where the stairs are.
I'm going to activate the seismic failsafe.
We'll be stuck between floors for hours.
Dwight K. Schrute, Dunder Mifflin, Scranton.
An appointment with Mr. Romish, please.
Dwight K. Schrute, Dunder Mifflin, Scranton.
Mr. Romish, Harry Janarone, Dunder Mifflin, Syracuse.
I already made an appointment with your secretary.
Let me stop you all right here.
I've already picked a new paper supplier.
Wait, it's not Dunder Mifflin, is it?
It's not Dunder Mifflin at all, actually.
Give me a cup of coffee.
Or you also have a monopoly on thirst.
All right, guys, it didn't work out for any of us, so we're still on the same team.
You know, your partner's got a lot of attitude, but I like that.
How long have you guys been dating?
Jim couldn't land me in a thousand years.
But you're saying there's a chance.
